thread:
Samira: hey team — sharing here because i don't want to escalate but i need an accommodation. i've got ASD and my executive function + sensory stuff has gotten worse lately. asking for: flexible start (9:30-11a), no back-to-back meetings, and a noise-dampening headset / quiet desk for 60 days. worried about how this intersects with the sprint and my upcoming review. any guidance?

Chris - Manager: Samira thanks for telling us. i support you asking for help. quick context: we're shipping the analytics feature in 6 weeks. we can reshuffle some meetings but we'll need to keep core syncs. i don't want this to turn into a performance thing — let's work with People Ops to make a short plan.

Alex - People Ops: hi Samira — we can absolutely set this up without immediate performance consequences. typical flow: 1) interactive conversation to confirm needs, 2) draft a time-limited accommodation (e.g., 60 days) with concrete changes, 3) adjust OKRs/sprint scope if needed and document the plan. we won't add subjective notes to your review; only factual accommodations. can we book a 20m private call today?

Samira: appreciate that. i want adjustments but i'm anxious about manager notes. prefer wording like "temporary scheduling and workspace adjustments" only.

Riley - HR: Samira — that's doable. provider documentation helpful but not required. we can also offer an internal job-coach consult (30m) and a checklist for meeting-free focus blocks. for the review: we can reweight deliverables or move a subset to the next cycle.

Jordan: i can cover any meetings you want skipped and take notes. happy to help with demos. :thumbsup:

Chris - Manager: concrete idea: reduce Samira's meeting load to core triage + design sync, move grooming to asynchronous comments, and allow flexible start. engineering will swap review tasks. this is not a PIP.

Alex - People Ops: draft accommodation snippet we can sign today:

```
Accommodation: temporary schedule + workspace (60 days)
- Schedule: flexible start window 9:30011:00, no recurring meetings before 11:00 except core sync (Tue 10:30)
- Meetings: max 3 synchronous meetings/day; encourage async updates
- Workspace: priority quiet desk and noise-dampening headset for on-site days
- Performance: reweight sprint tasks; defer 2 low-priority items; biweekly check-ins (15m) with manager + People Ops
- Documentation: confidential accommodation letter stored by HR
```

Alex - People Ops: if that looks right i'll put this in a formal accommodation note and coordinate with engineering for the sprint scope changes.

Samira: that template is perfect. i don't want a formal PIP. i can do the biweekly check-ins.

Riley - HR: next steps: 1) 20m private call today to finalize wording, 2) Alex will file the confidential note, 3) Chris + Jordan will update sprint board to reflect deferred items. we'll run the 60-day trial and reassess.

Chris - Manager: i'll update the sprint after the call. thanks for raising this — we should normalize asking for these adjustments.

Samira: thank you all. really helps to have a clear path. i'll take the call this afternoon.

Alex - People Ops: DMing calendar invite now. all sensitive details stay in HR records only. :lock:
